translations.web: I made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them.”
translations.bsb: And I have made Your name known to them and will continue to make it known, so that the love You have for Me may be in them, and I in them.”
translations.kjv: And I have declared unto them thy name, and will declare it: that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.
translations.asv: and I made known unto them thy name, and will make it known; that the love wherewith thou lovedst me may be in them, and I in them.
